newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson forms JV on SDH in China.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson forms JV on SDH in China.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Thursday it had set up a joint venture in China with Wuhan Research Institute to develop, make and market Synchronous Digital Hierarchy (SDH) transport network systems.
Ericsson said in a statement that the new company, Wuhan Yangtze Ericsson Tgelecommunication Co Ltd (YEC), would start production in September 1997.
The business scope of the new company would include marketing, sales, implementation, service solutions and design of locally adapted SDH network solutions for the Chinese market.
In the longer term, the company may expand its business scope to include other products for multimedia networks, Ericsson said.
The company is expected to have about 200 employees by 1999.
The Wuhan Research Institute was set up in 1974 by the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications and is the first and largest supplier of transmission and fibre-optic equipment to the Chinese market.
